title: PURSUE Release 2 - official record index (all 64 records: documents, videos, images, audio)
doc_notes: This is an official index of 64 declassified records from the PURSUE-R2 collection, containing one firsthand encounter report.

encounters.summary: A senior intelligence official recounts encountering unidentified glowing orbs at close range and at a distance while a passenger in a helicopter, including an object that split in two and accelerated away.
encounters.quote: recounts encountering unidentified “glowing orbs” both at close range and at a distance
